target.title: fix(sessions): reply session init fails under rapid consecutive turns
target.body:
## Summary

Fixes transient `reply session initialization conflicted` failures by replacing the single stale-snapshot retry in reply-session initialization with a bounded 4-attempt budget.

## Details

`commitReplySessionInitialization` uses an expected-revision guard. Under rapid same-session turns, another writer can advance the session-store revision between snapshot and commit more than once. The previous code retried once, then surfaced the conflict to the user.

This keeps the same snapshot, commit, locking, and failure semantics. It only increases the bounded retry budget for stale snapshots.

## Validation

Added `src/auto-reply/reply/session-init-retry-budget.test.ts`, which uses the real file-backed `loadReplySessionInitializationSnapshot` and `commitReplySessionInitialization` functions:

```text
old budget (2 attempts) throws under a 3-writer burst
new budget (4 attempts) succeeds under the identical 3-writer burst
```

Checked locally:

```text
npx vitest run src/auto-reply/reply/session-init-retry-budget.test.ts src/auto-reply/reply/session.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/polling-session.test.ts
Test Files  3 passed (3)
Tests       201 passed (201)
```

Also checked:

```text
npx oxlint src/auto-reply/reply/session.ts src/auto-reply/reply/session-init-retry-budget.test.ts
npx oxfmt --check src/auto-reply/reply/session-init-retry-budget.test.ts
npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.core.json
```

`tsc` has no new errors; the existing `TS4058` in `src/secrets/config-io.ts` reproduces on `main`.

## Notes

This is a small mitigation for transient same-session write races. It does not replace the related root-cause work in #98416 or #98835.
